about.title: About Me
about.description1: I’m a 21-year-old Mexican Software Engineering student currently in my 8th semester. I strive to balance my academic journey with professional development and entrepreneurial interests. I consider myself a creative, adaptable, and disciplined individual with strong critical thinking skills.
about.description2: I believe in the power of continuous learning and growth, always seeking knowledge from the incredible people around me. Every day presents new opportunities, and I strive to recognize and seize them while creating my own path forward.
about.description3: My interests span from science and human behavior to economics and politics, but my true passion lies in technology, artificial intelligence, theoretical physics, and philosophy.
